blue.usage: Primary buttons, links, selected chips/tabs, data lines, dots, line icons, highlighted headline word.
blue.tonalRampNote: Steps 2-4 and 6-8 are the project's own --blue-700, --blue, --blue-300, --blue-100, --blue-050 and Field Wash; steps 1 and 5 are synthesised in OKLCH.

blue-700.usage: Primary hover, link text on pale fills, roles, step numerals, selected-tab titles.

blue-300.usage: Strokes of idle dots, hover borders, focus ring, bar gradient start, glows. Never text on white (2.62:1).

blue-100.usage: Input focus halo, rails, current status segment, tracks.

blue-050.usage: Table heads, skill chips, ghost hover wipe, default tag fill, selected tab tint.

ink.usage: Headings, strong text, dark count block and close band gradient start.

navy-mid.usage: Middle stop of the dark gradients (count readout, close band, sv-dark).

muted.usage: Captions, breadcrumbs, secondary meta (effective value from stage.css).

line.usage: Idle borders of chips, inputs, cards, proof strip.

field-wash.usage: Start of the .fx-sec--alt gradient (ends #FBFCFE), always with the 56px grid mask.

edge-card.usage: Border of report sheets, records and journal entries inside panels.

edge-row.usage: Table and list dividers inside panels.

track.usage: Idle segment of the chevron status bar.

ok.usage: Done, balanced, later/exempt verdicts, gain bars.

amber.usage: Sample data tag, placeholder, warnings, likely verdict.

hero-title.purpose: .fx-hero h1 / .fx-h on the home hero panels. Max 15ch, balanced; the highlighted word is Blue with a drawn 0.1em underline.

page-title.purpose: Inner-page fx heroes (.sv-hero, .ph-hero, .bir-fx .bf-hero, .cx-hero). Max 17-22ch. Industries use clamp(2rem, 1.2rem + 2.2vw, 3rem).

section-title.purpose: .sec-head h2, .fx-who h2, .ixf-two h2. A full sentence in Ink; never a label.

card-title.purpose: .fx-node h3 (21px), .pf-card h3 (19px), chain step titles scale up to 1.75rem.

panel-title.purpose: Record and panel headers: .ixf-t b, .fx-sheet-t, .sv-bar b (15-17px).

numeral.purpose: KPIs and countdown: tabular-nums 800; 30px count readout, 22px record KPIs, 16px on phones.

lead.purpose: One paragraph under a title, max 64ch (hero lead 1.13rem / 1.6, 52ch).

label.purpose: Tags, pills, table heads, chip text. 12-13px, 700, no tracking, no uppercase. Floor 12px.

shadows.name: inner-light
shadows.purpose: Top inner highlight added to every glass panel.

shadows.name: tab-selected
shadows.purpose: Chosen report or industry tab (ring plus soft shadow).

shadows.name: glow-lit
shadows.purpose: A lit data dot or timeline node.

motion.name: fx-ease
motion.purpose: The house curve (ease-out expo): --fx-ease, --ease-expo, --bt-ease, and --spring rebound inside fx pages.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Shell UI: mega menu, drawers, reveals (--ease-out).

motion.name: spring
motion.purpose: Shell buttons and icon pops only (--spring in site.css); not used inside fx pages.

motion.name: panel-cycle
motion.value: stages at 0.5 / 1.9 / 3.5 / 4.7 s, restart at 11.5 s
motion.purpose: Sample Odoo record replay (.ixf-panel); waits while off-screen or document.hidden.

motion.name: loops
motion.value: beam 1.8s, rail 3.6s, edge spin 5s, orb drift 18-22s, ping 1.6s

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: JS skips .is-js; animations none; transitions none; .reveal visible; live edge becomes a static ring.

breakpoints.name: desktop-fx
breakpoints.purpose: fx grids go single column; sticky panels static; report tabs 3 cols; industry tabs become a pill row.

breakpoints.name: shell
breakpoints.purpose: Desktop nav -> drawer; header 72 -> 64px; side tabs -> round + fan; page .two grids stack.

breakpoints.name: control-tower
breakpoints.purpose: BIR control tower becomes console + chip row; fx-check stacks.

breakpoints.name: phone
breakpoints.purpose: Section padding 72px; 1-column grids; tables scroll in card; full-width buttons.

display.stack: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', 'Jakarta Fallback', Inter, 'Inter Fallback', system-ui, sans-serif

body.note: CSS also asks for 650/700, which resolve to 600.

glass.field: Glass must sit over .fx-field, .fx-sec--alt or a tinted wash; on plain white it reads as a flat card.

classCatalogue.description: Scope for glass tokens: --fx-glass, --fx-edge, --fx-line, --fx-grid, --fx-depth, --fx-depth-h, --fx-amber, --fx-ease. Home body is .is-home.fx-home; inner pages .fx-page + page class (.ind-fx, .bir-fx, .svc-fx, .ph-fx, .gs-fx, .art-fx, .cx-page).
104px section (72px phones); alt = Field Wash gradient + 56px grid mask.
Max 760px, 48px below; H2 + one lead.
Two-column hero 1.08fr / .92fr on a glow-and-grid field with drifting orbs.
Glass pill with the Odoo Ready Partner mark above the H1.
Hero title, highlighted word with drawn underline, hero lead.
Home slide 3: BIR control tower (hero-bir.css, hero-bir.js).
Home slide 4: readiness check (bir-check.js). Not a home section.
Buttons (site.css; calm.css retunes heights on inner pages).
44px tap chip over a hidden radio/checkbox.
Status pills and tags: covered/likely/later/exempt/pending.
Amber 'Sample data' tag (required on illustrative figures).
Glass panels with the live conic edge.

Dark navy count readout (days, hours, minutes) with tabular numerals.
Step list on a 2px rail with ring dots that light up.
Report viewer pieces: ledger rows, travelling beam, white report sheet, sample table.
Five report tabs (role=tablist).

Practices rail of three glass nodes.
Journey stepper and timeline variants.

Who we are copy + glass client wall.
Industry link tile (bare line icon + name + one line).
Proof strip between hairlines.
Glass FAQ rows, one open.
Navy close band with the two actions.
Dark navy section variant on service pages; h2 needs color:#fff !important.
Set by IntersectionObserver to pause loops off-screen.
Scroll reveal and count-up hooks.
Visually hidden text, skip link, flat Odoo icon, line icon.

hardRules: Light theme only; no dark mode.
No icon tiles: bare line icons and flat Odoo icons.
No eyebrows or kickers; headings are sentences.
Sample data is always labelled 'Sample data'.
Never BIR-accredited / certified / compliant for software; say 'set up for BIR requirements'.
No prices; Odoo is never described as free.
No WhatsApp number or link; WhatsApp only as an Odoo product feature.
Nexi only in the Ask Nexi launcher, the Nexi Explains series and the home hero.
Finished state is the default markup; prefers-reduced-motion shows it; loops pause off-screen.
inconsistencies: --muted: #8888A0 (site.css, 3.46:1 on white) vs #62627A (stage.css, wins as loaded later) vs #5E5E78 (.aix-fx) vs #5C5F78 (.gs-fx main); --muted-a11y duplicates #62627A.

Amber: --amber #A96B00 on --amber-050 #FDF6E9 (site.css, 4.08:1, fails) vs --fx-amber #8F5A00 on #FDF3E1 (home-fx, hero-bir, 5.26:1); .ind-fx/.aix-fx rebind --amber to #8F5A00; --gold #D69A00 in stage.css.

--spring: bouncy cubic-bezier(.34,1.45,.64,1) in site.css but rebound to cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1) inside .ind-fx/.aix-fx/.mkt-fx/.erp-fx/.qt-fx/.svc-fx; --ease-expo defined in stage.css and again in three page scopes; five easing names total (--fx-ease, --bt-ease, --ease-out, --spring, --w-ease).
Glass tokens duplicated: --glass/--glass-line (site.css, .72/.9) vs --fx-glass/--fx-edge (home-fx, .72/.95); hero-bir and industry-fx hard-code .82/.86/.92 variants.
Hairline greys: --line #E7E4E9 (warm) vs --calm-line #E4E8F0 (cool) vs #E3E9F5 and #EEF1F7 literals; --blue-100 #DDE7F8 vs --calm-accent-line #C9D7F1.
Radius has no token scale in fx: --r-sm 8 / --r 14 / --r-lg 20 in site.css, but fx uses 10-28px literals; the same role varies (glass card 22 vs 24 vs 26; close band 28; .ixf-rec/.fx-ledger 20).

Inter weights 650 and 700 are used widely but Google Fonts requests Inter 400/500/600 only (700 resolves to 600); Caveat (500/600/700) is still requested although calm.css remaps --font-hand to the display face.

Text under 12px: .fx-count small 11.5px, .pf-card[data-ph]::after 11.5px, hero-bir .bt-days 11.5px / .bt-sample 11px / .bt-node small 11.5px, and 100+ declarations of 9-11.5px in hero.css (slide 1 and 2 scenes); stage.css phone audit pins demo small print at 11px with !important.
Focus ring: global :focus-visible is 2px solid --blue (offset 2); fx components use 3px solid --blue-300 #6FA0F5 (offset 3), which is 2.62:1 on white (<3:1 for UI strokes).

Three H2 scales: site.css clamp(1.75rem,3.1vw,2.6rem); fx clamp(1.9rem,1.2rem+2vw,2.85rem); calm.css clamp(1.7rem,2.6vw,2.35rem) !important (ind-fx overrides back with !important). Six H1 scales across hero.css, home-fx, page-hero, ind-fx, bir-fx, svc-fx, cx-hero.
Button height: .btn 46px (lg 52, sm 38) on the home page (calm.css not loaded) vs 48/48/40 with lift, sweep and ::before/::after removed on inner pages (calm.css); active scale .96 vs .98.

calm.css still styles .hand/.h1-hand/.eyebrow as uppercase tracked kickers with the plane mark (!important); site.css keeps .eyebrow, .card-kicker; .cw-h and .mega-head are uppercase tracked labels. None appear in the home markup (verified) but the classes remain available.

Dead legacy: .wa-float WhatsApp-green (#25D366) rules in site.css although no page emits a WhatsApp button (.wa-float-tip is reused by the catalogue button); .nexi-tab violet gradient #6B5BFF overridden by flat blue; 29 tile-style .ic-ind icon definitions in sitedata.py (build swaps to flat ic-flat).

Off-accent hues in hero scenes: --tok-buy #D97B12, --tok-make #7447D6, --tok-late #D2433B, --tok-pay #0E9384 (hero.css process map), --odoo #714B67 (.tag--odoo), hero-skins.css Nexi palettes. Intentional scene data hues, not part of the page system.
Breakpoints: fx uses 1080/900/600/480 plus 1000, 980, 860, 767, 760, 720, 700, 640, 420; shell uses 960/1100/640. Between 961-1080px the header is desktop while fx heroes are already single column.
Section padding: .section 96/56 (site) vs .fx-sec 104/72 vs .art-fx 88 vs .fx-hero--sec 96/104 vs close band 24/104 (home) or 24/96 (ind-fx).

Bring your BIR deadline to an adviser.

narrative.overview:
TechNext is a trusted expert adviser for ERP and BIR compliance. The site must feel like the books of a firm that already knows the rules: calm, exact, a little ahead of its time. Odoo records (an invoice, a journal entry, a report sheet) are the hero material. They are drawn as frosted glass panels floating on a faint blue grid, and the story moves along thin glowing data lines that connect one record to the next. This is today's TechNext system (blue #3167CA on white, Plus Jakarta Sans display, Inter body) rendered futuristic, not a new identity.

Density is moderate and editorial: big plain sentences as headings, one primary action per view ("Book a discovery call"), proof next to claims. Colour is restrained: one blue accent on white, status hues only for status. Depth comes from light (hairline edges, inner highlight, blue-tinted shadows, blur), never from heavy dark chrome. Everything is light theme only.

Voice: adviser first, then implementer. British spelling ("adviser", "localisation"). Lead verbs advise, recommend, deliver. Headings are full sentences ("Your BIR reports, from the entries you already post."), never labels over headings. Sample figures are always fictitious and always tagged "Sample data".
keyCharacteristics: Frosted glass records (white at 72%, 1px white edge, inner top highlight, blue-tinted drop shadow) on a blue hairline grid.
One accent (blue #3167CA) with Deep Blue for hover and small text; status hues (green, amber) only on pills, tags and verdicts.
Live sample Odoo panels that replay a record: status bar, KPIs count up, lines fill, a journal entry posts with Dr = Cr.
Glowing data lines, travelling dots and a masked rotating edge as the only decorative motion; all transform/opacity.
Bare line icons and official flat Odoo app icons; no tiles, no illustrations, no cartoon art, no gradient text.
Reduced motion shows the finished state; loops pause off-screen.

rules.name: The One Blue Rule
rules.body: Blue #3167CA is the only accent. Status colours appear only inside pills, tags, verdicts and bars; they never decorate a section, a heading or an icon.

rules.name: The Not-On-White Rule
rules.body: Sky Blue (#6FA0F5) is for strokes and glows. Any text on white or a pale wash is Body Slate, Ink, Deep Blue or Blue (all >= 4.5:1).

rules.name: The Light Only Rule
rules.body: No dark mode, no `prefers-color-scheme: dark`, `color-scheme: light` on :root. Dark appears only as a deliberate navy block (count readout, close band, `.sv-dark`).

rules.name: The Sentence Rule
rules.body: Headings are complete sentences in Ink. No eyebrow, kicker or small-caps line above or below a heading, no tracking-wide uppercase labels.

rules.name: The Twelve Pixel Floor Rule
rules.body: No text under 12px in new work (phones included). Tables and panel microcopy go to 12-12.5px, not 10-11px.

rules.name: The Field Rule
rules.body: Glass only reads over a field. Place it on `.fx-field`, `.fx-sec--alt` or a tinted wash, never on plain white.

rules.name: The Light Over Shadow Rule
rules.body: Depth is a bright inner edge plus a long, low-opacity blue shadow. No black drop shadows, no hard outlines for emphasis (use the selected-tab ring).

rules.name: The Finished State Rule
rules.body: The default markup is the finished composition; motion only describes how it arrives, so a script that fails or a visitor who prefers reduced motion still sees everything.

rules.name: The Bare Icon Rule
rules.body: An icon sits directly on its surface in Blue or its own colours. No tile, disc, tint or border behind it, in menus, cards, chips or panels.

dos: **Do** build every new section from the glass recipe over a field or wash, with Ink headings (sentences), Body Slate copy, one Blue action.
**Do** show real Odoo screens, records, journal entries and report sheets with fictitious figures, tagged "Sample data" (amber pill) on the same panel.
**Do** make one primary action per view: "Book a discovery call" (Odoo booking). Secondary: "See sample BIR reports", the Services Catalogue, the inquiry form.
**Do** say "set up for BIR requirements" and "adviser"; cite the rule (RR 26-2025, 31 December 2026) next to the claim.
**Do** keep motion on transform and opacity, 0.2-0.9s, house easing; pause loops off-screen; make the markup default the finished state.
**Do** give all interactive targets >= 44px on phones and a visible `:focus-visible` ring (3px Sky Blue, 3px offset on glass; site default 2px Blue, 2px offset).
**Do** keep `h2` colour in dark panels explicit: calm.css forces `main section h2 { color: var(--ink) !important }`, so `.fx-close h2`, `.sv-dark h2` and similar must use `color: #fff !important`.
donts: **Don't** add a dark mode or any `prefers-color-scheme: dark` styling. Light only.
**Don't** put icons on tiles, discs or tinted backdrops; icons are bare. Don't recolour Odoo icons.

**Don't** use eyebrows, kickers or small-caps/tracked uppercase lines above or below headings (`.eyebrow`, `.card-kicker`, `.hand`, `.h1-hand`, `.sc-kicker` are legacy and must not appear in fx pages).
**Don't** use gradient text, background-clip text, or gradient headlines. The only text emphasis is Blue plus the drawn underline.
**Don't** use cartoon, comic or illustrated art, stickers, tilted labels, lips, textures or mascots in content. Imagery is real UI, real records, real screens.
**Don't** present sample data unlabelled. Sample, fictitious or placeholder values always say so on the same panel ("Sample data", "Placeholder").
**Don't** write "BIR-accredited", "BIR-certified" or "BIR-compliant" about software or TechNext. Use "set up for BIR requirements".
**Don't** show prices or "from $" anywhere. **Don't** call Odoo free; only TechNext's design and setup labour can be free, and the client pays its own Odoo subscription.
**Don't** add a WhatsApp number or link, a floating WhatsApp button or a wa.me URL. WhatsApp may be named only as an Odoo product feature.
**Don't** use Nexi in page content. Nexi appears only in the Ask Nexi launcher (side tab), the Nexi Explains series pages, and the home hero (and hides on hero slide 4).

**Don't** bring back removed pages (offices, Technology, RAG, careers, events, life, advisers) or invent testimonials, result metrics, case-study outcomes, adviser names or accreditation claims; none are on file.
**Don't** animate layout properties, loop animations off-screen, or hide content behind motion that may not run.
**Don't** set text below 12px, or put Sky Blue (#6FA0F5) text on white.
accessibility: Text contrast >= 4.5:1, UI strokes and focus >= 3:1. Verified pairs: Blue on white 5.35, white on Blue 5.35, Ink 15.9, Body 8.3, Muted 5.9, Green on Green Wash 4.79, Amber on Amber Wash 5.26, Deep Blue on Wash Blue 7.84, Blue on Wash Blue 4.68 (avoid below 14px bold).
Tabs: role tablist/tab/tabpanel, aria-selected, aria-controls, roving tabindex, Arrow/Home/End. Toggles: aria-pressed.
Live results use `aria-live="polite"`; chip groups are `fieldset` plus `legend` with real radio inputs; the visible chip is the `span` after the focusable input and shows the focus ring.
`.sr-only` for icon-only labels; `.skip` link first in the page; headings in order (one H1); decorative field, orbs and grid are `aria-hidden`.
Tables keep real th/td; on phones they scroll in their card with a visible hint.
Spoken order matches visual order; nothing important is conveyed by colour alone (pills carry text).
